ol.chatPh: Visible to everyone · press Enter to type
ol.chatNote: Public chat: everyone online can read it. Only the latest 20 messages are kept; there are no private messages.
ol.title: Online
ol.setup2: Please wait a little longer. Play vs AI, rated games, 2-player games, lessons and puzzles work as usual.
ol.findDesc: You are paired with someone of similar rating (rated game).
ol.noRoom: Room not found or already started
ol.roomInfoOpen: Shown in the list. You can also send the code or link.
ol.roomInfoKey: Only people with the code or link can join.
ol.roomExpired: The room timed out and was closed
ol.pReopen: Your opponent left. The room stays open
ol.leaveQ: A game is in progress. Resign and leave?
ol.moveFail: Move not sent. Re-syncing the board
pf.title: Profile
pf.desc: Choose the name shown in online games. You can change it later with "Change name" in the online panel.
pf.name: Name (up to 16 characters)
pf.gdesc: Link a Google account to sync lesson, tsumego and joseki progress, your daily streak, rated games vs the AI, settings, name and online rating between PC and phone.
sync.title: Google link
sync.desc: Link a Google account to sync your progress and rating between PC and phone.
sync.logoutQ: Sign out of Google? This device becomes a new anonymous player (progress stays on this device).
sync.switched: Switched to your Google account and synced
err.domain: This site ({d}) is not an authorized domain in Firebase. Add it in Firebase console → Authentication → Settings → Authorized domains.
err.provider: This sign-in method is disabled. Enable "Google" and "Anonymous" in Firebase console → Authentication → Sign-in method.
err.referrer: Blocked by the API key's HTTP referrer restriction. Allow {d} in Google Cloud console → Credentials → API key.
err.apikey: The API key is invalid. Check firebase-config.js.
err.network: No network connection. Check your connection.
err.popup: The popup was blocked. Signing in on a new page instead.
err.config: Firebase Authentication is not enabled (press "Get started" in the console).
ol.ngDesc: Play people from around the world: automatic pairing with someone of similar rating, or create a room for a friend.
ol.endedAway: Your last online game had ended: {r}
ol.rtLeft: The rated game vs the AI was abandoned for the online game
ol.endNote: Online games: no handicap, komi 6.5. When both players pass in a row the game ends; the AI judges the dead stones and counts the score automatically.
ol.cntAuto: Both players passed and the game is over. The AI judged the dead stones (faded) automatically.
